evals.name: tinytodo-p1-happy
evals.prompt: I have a rolling-wave plan at tinytodo-plan.md for a small CLI project. Please execute the current phase (P1) — implement the tasks, tick the checkboxes, and produce the implementation report.
evals.expected_output: A working CLI project (tinytodo/ package with code), all four P1 task checkboxes flipped to [x] in the plan file, and a phase-P1-report.md following the schema's report template. The end-to-end test should actually pass when run.
